files.app/jobs/application_job.rb:
class ApplicationJob < ActiveJob::Base
  retry_on Net::ReadTimeout, wait: :polynomially_longer, attempts: 5
  discard_on ActiveJob::DeserializationError
  around_perform :with_account_scope

  def self.throttle(limit:, period:)
    self.throttle_settings = { limit: limit, period: period }
  end

  def with_account_scope(&block)
    Current.set(account_id: arguments.first, &block)
  end
end
files.app/jobs/vendors/base_sync_job.rb:
module Vendors
  class BaseSyncJob < ApplicationJob
    queue_as :vendor_sync
    retry_on Vendors::RateLimited, wait: 30.seconds, attempts: 10
    throttle limit: 20, period: 1.minute

    def perform(account_id, cursor = nil)
      max_pages.times do
        cursor = fetch_page(cursor)
        break if cursor.nil?
      end
    end

    def fetch_page(_cursor)
      raise NotImplementedError
    end

    def max_pages
      50
    end
  end
end
files.app/jobs/vendors/acme_sync_job.rb:
module Vendors
  class AcmeSyncJob < BaseSyncJob
    def fetch_page(cursor)
      response = AcmeClient.new.list_invoices(cursor: cursor)
      Invoices::Import.call(response.items)
      response.next_cursor
    end

    def max_pages
      200
    end
  end
end
files.app/jobs/vendors/globex_sync_job.rb:
module Vendors
  class GlobexSyncJob < BaseSyncJob
    discard_on Globex::AccountClosed

    def fetch_page(cursor)
      GlobexClient.new.page(cursor)
    end
  end
end
